decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed materials for the hard landscaping and boundary treatment are considered to be acceptable and the Council is satisfied that the appearance and character of the area would be improved, in line with Policy ENV-B 1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of 2 multi storey car parks and erection of 11 houses on the east car park site and 4 houses and 24 flats on the west car park site; installation of external lighting, close circuit television, alterations to existing car parking and access roads, hard and soft landscaping, children's play facilities, dog walking area, alterations to drying areas and new bin stores, details submitted pursuant to Condition 5 (part approval for hard landscaping only), and Condition 7 (boundary treatment) of approved planning permission ref:01310/G/P2 dated 22/03/05.
